stackDivergence.rationale: Original source responsibilities retain actual RTL/UNO owners and contracts. Explicit disposal, borrowed UTF16 views, pointer-address cells, compiler overload witnesses and realm-local execution bind the browser host; physical native ABI/thread guarantees remain unqualified.

preservedResponsibilities: Original UriReferenceFactory.cxx generic URI component and lexical helpers over native RTL/UNO owners. Full factory/service orchestration is separate; no string-facing parser or provider substitutes for it.
omittedResponsibilities: Independent native compiled module differential, physical ABI/allocator/mutex/thread lifetime and runtime shutdown are unqualified.
Complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/package/desktop/mobile UI import-export acceptance remains unfinished; existing browser open/save/autosave/recovery choices are retained.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The original header and implementation or inline responsibilities share a native basename. This explicit module boundary retains their distinct import identities and the same actual receiver/owner while the original source contracts stay mapped to the pinned translation unit.
